title: Merge Similar Items
summary: Given two 2D integer arrays, items1 and items2, each containing unique values and weights, return a 2D array where each element contains a unique value and the sum of weights of all items sharing that value, sorted in ascending order by value.
statement: Given two 2D integer arrays, items1 and items2, each containing unique values and weights, return a 2D array where each element contains a unique value and the sum of weights of all items sharing that value, sorted in ascending order by value.
constraints: Each item is [value,weight], and values are unique within each input list.
Combine weights for equal values across the two lists.
Return [value,total_weight] pairs in increasing value order.
hints: Use a dictionary from item value to accumulated weight.
Add every pair from both lists into the same dictionary.
Iterate sorted dictionary keys to build the result.
Each input weight contributes once to its value, and sorted keys enforce the output contract.
editorial: Each input weight contributes once to its value, and sorted keys enforce the output contract.

tests.explanation: Values one and three combine across lists, and the sorted result is [[1,6],[3,9],[4,5]].
Every value occurs in both lists, producing totals four, four, and four.
